sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((COALESCE(((SELECT min(e.occurred_at) FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) > $3::timestamptz), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT min(e.occurred_at) FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) < $3::timestamptz), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT min(e.occurred_at) FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) <@ tstzrange($3::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz, '[)')), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT min(e.occurred_at) FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) <= $5::timestamptz), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT min(e.occurred_at) FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) <@ tstzrange($6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz, '(]')), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT min(e.occurred_at) FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) <@ tstzrange($7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz, '[)')), false)))
